items.headline: Council to discuss potential lawsuit against fire truck makers
items.summary: The City Council is scheduled to meet in closed session to discuss a potential legal case involving fire apparatus manufacturers Golden State Fire Apparatus, Pierce Manufacturing, Oshkosh, REV Group, Rosenbauer America, and the Fire Apparatus Manufacturers' Association.

items.headline: Chamberlain Drive lots add both ADU and JADU units
items.summary: On Chamberlain Dr, Lot 6 received a permit for a new detached ADU ($131,940) while Lot 3 received a permit for an attached JADU ($86,130), pointing to a subdivision where multiple lots are adding secondary units.

items.headline: TIAA signage approved at 2875 El Camino Real
items.summary: Architectural review cleared three illuminated wall signs for TIAA at 2875 El Camino Real, indicating the financial firm's move into that space.

items.headline: Massage Envy wall signs approved on El Camino Real
items.summary: Two LED channel-letter wall signs for Massage Envy were approved at 2515 El Camino Real, signaling the business's opening at that location.

items.headline: Matching two-story ADUs permitted on S 10th Street
items.summary: Identical 2-story detached ADUs with garages, each valued at $115,447, were permitted the same day at 685 and 687 S 10th St, suggesting coordinated construction on adjacent lots.

items.headline: Council approves cost-share deal with San Jose for resurfacing
items.summary: The City Council approved a cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose, not to exceed $335,000, to fund resurfacing work.

items.headline: Council updates Theater Use Policy, effective September 16
items.summary: The City Council adopted a resolution modifying Council Policy Section 14, the city's Theater Use Policy, effective September 16.
